note: The core is Virtual Jaguar (virtualjaguar-libretro, GPL-3.0), with this repository's integration (MIT). The program is distributed under the GPL version 3. Compiled in from Virtual Jaguar's own tree: libretro-common (MIT) and libchdr (BSD-3-Clause) with LZMA (public domain), miniz (MIT) and zstd (BSD), and, as upstream's builds carry them, the Atari Jaguar's boot ROMs and Jaguar CD BIOSes (src/bios; Hasbro Interactive released the Jaguar as an open platform in 1999). The package contains no game.

components.name: Atari Jaguar boot ROMs and Jaguar CD BIOSes (in Virtual Jaguar, src/bios)
components.license: Atari's, released with the Jaguar as an open platform by Hasbro Interactive (1999); shipped as upstream ships them
